name: JointRF Representation
definition: A compact residual feature grid and a coefficient feature grid to represent the dynamic NeRF. This representation handles large motions without compromising quality while concurrently diminishing temporal redundancy.
summary: JointRF is a compact residual feature grid representation for dynamic NeRFs that handles large motions and long sequences by decomposing the radiance field into a long-reference basis feature grid and a coefficient feature grid.
